title: A Tracy-Widom Central Limit Theorem
exact_target: Find a probabilistic analogue of the central limit theorem whose limit is a random-matrix spacing or edge law.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000010 (AMR-079-0010). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 10.

status_qualification: The original asks What is X rather than fixing last-passage percolation as the only operation. The Gaudin target as well as Tracy–Widom is retained. It is a characterization programme, not a statement that every i.i.d. law has such an edge limit without hypotheses.
